$comment: Bundled defaults for shell verbs the approval gate auto-allows on Windows when invoked inside an audience-aware safe space (session_dir + project_dir for Personal/Team; session_dir only for Public). Each entry is a verb chain matched by exact equality against ShellTokenizer.ExtractVerbChain output. Includes both cmd.exe builtins and PowerShell read-only cmdlets, plus the same git read subcommands as the Linux list. Mutating verbs are intentionally absent.
